recommendations.description: Conduct a targeted prior-auth-to-claim, denial-enforcement, and contract-compliance audit for VA pa_required_code Y acute hospital admissions at SENTARA NORFOLK GENERAL HOSPITAL, SENTARA LEIGH HOSPITAL, VCU MEDICAL CENTER, CARILION ROANOKE MEMORIAL HOSPITAL, and CHIPPENHAM HOSPITAL across DSNP HMO, Medicare HMO, and CSNP HMO, and implement provider-specific contract remediation or site-of-care controls for confirmed outliers.
evidence: VA DSNP HMO acute spend rose +$99.0M with 6,177 more admissions.
VA Medicare HMO acute added +$64.3M with 3,834 more admissions.
VA CSNP HMO acute added +$26.3M on 1,740 more admissions.
Sentara Norfolk General Hospital DSNP HMO delta +$7.6M; admissions +363.
VCU Medical Center and Carilion each contributed about +$6.2M to +$6.6M.
Chippenham Hospital Medicare HMO paid per admit increased +$1.4K.
All cited acute hospital source cards have pa_required_code Y.

recommendations.description: Implement TX ACUTE HOSPITAL prior-auth-to-claim match edits and denial enforcement for DSNP HMO and CSNP HMO IP Med/Surg ER admissions, with CTI discharge-planning escalation for repeat same-facility members at BEN TAUB HOSPITAL.
evidence: Prior auth required code Y across TX DSNP HMO and CSNP HMO acute hospital claims.
DSNP HMO added 3,685 admissions with average paid per admit essentially flat.
CSNP HMO added 449 admissions while average paid per admit fell.
Drill context shows IP Med/Surg ER admits at BEN TAUB HOSPITAL.
peer_benchmarking: Humana bills only medically necessary observation time, generally limited to 48 hours.

recommendations.description: Pause TX DSNP HMO IP Med/Surg prior-authorization or provider actions until a claims-processing validation review reconciles AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION to actual authorizations, remaps facility_type Not Mapped, confirms contractual reprocessing, and blocks manual adjudication overrides of key edits.
evidence: AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION movement accounts for about +$53.8M of change.
TX DSNP HMO Not Mapped adds about +$9.3M on 252 admissions.
Validation flags show auth_or_mapping_shift and requires_validation_before_action.
peer_benchmarking: Humana requires auth and uses facility-only site of care.

recommendations.description: Run a provider-level auth-to-claim validation and claims reprocessing audit for VA Medicare Indiv IP Med/Surg acute hospital claims mapped to AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION at VCU Medical Center, Chippenham Hospital, Carilion Roanoke Memorial Hospital, Sentara Norfolk General Hospital, and Sentara Leigh Hospital, and correct authorization-denial enforcement before any UM or contract remediation.
evidence: VA AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION movement totals +$45.5M.
VCU Medical Center and Chippenham Hospital lead the shift.
Cards are flagged auth_or_mapping_shift and requires_validation_before_action.
Driver type is coding_or_mapping_validation across VA acute hospitals.
peer_benchmarking: Molina performs pre-payment and post-payment DRG clinical validation on hospital claims.
United Health reviews inpatient UB-04 claims and denies the claim for invalid principal diagnosis.

recommendations.description: In VA, implement a SNF/NF payment integrity policy that enforces auth-to-claim matching and denial edits, validates contract exceptions and manual adjudication for DSNP HMO SNF - FREE STANDING claims, and requires alternate-discharge leakage review for Bone Diseases and Arthropathies with MCC, BILATERAL PRIM OSTEOARTHRITIS KNEE, and OSTEOMYELITIS UNSPECIFIED NF episodes.
evidence: VA DSNP HMO SNF without authorization added +$50.9M on 5,828 admissions.
Bone Diseases and Arthropathies with MCC added +$833.9K in SNF.
BILATERAL PRIM OSTEOARTHRITIS KNEE added +$345.5K in NF.
OSTEOMYELITIS UNSPECIFIED added +$111.1K across 10 NF admissions.
peer_benchmarking: Humana and United Health have no supplied SNF/NF policy details for benchmarking.

recommendations.description: Conduct a combined clinical-policy and reimbursement audit for OH Medicare HMO acute-hospital inpatient concomitant left atrial appendage closure and cardiac ablation admissions at Bethesda North Hospital, limited to paroxysmal and persistent atrial fibrillation cases with PA-required code Y, to validate diagnosis-specific appropriateness criteria, authorization-to-claim matching and denial enforcement, contract-compliant payment, and provider-specific contract or site-of-care remediation.
evidence: Concentrated inpatient spike centers on concomitant left atrial appendage closure and cardiac ablation.
Diagnosis cluster is paroxysmal and persistent atrial fibrillation.
Bethesda North Hospital is the rendering provider in the drill context.
Operational card shows PA-required code Y with auth_dimension_present.
Impact reflects admissions up and paid per admit up.

recommendations.description: Initiate a BEN TAUB HOSPITAL-focused TX IP Med/Surg review for Other Digestive System Diagnoses with MCC and Amputation for Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue Disorders with CC admissions involving OTH POSTPROC COMP D/O DIGESTIVE SYS, VASCULAR DISORDER INTESTINE UNS, and OTHER ACUTE OSTEOMYELITIS LEFT HAND; confirm prior authorization, review same-member repeat returns, and activate CTI and care-navigation outreach.
evidence: OTH POSTPROC COMP D/O DIGESTIVE SYS added the largest highlighted inpatient complication delta.
VASCULAR DISORDER INTESTINE UNS showed increased admissions within TX IP Med/Surg.
OTHER ACUTE OSTEOMYELITIS LEFT HAND was a new small-n high-cost admission.
Highlighted cards share BEN TAUB HOSPITAL, ACUTE HOSPITAL, and pa_required_code Y.
peer_benchmarking: Centene, Elevance, and Moda show no documented inpatient DRG policy in summary.
Molina documents outpatient routine foot care only, with no inpatient DRG reimbursement rule.

recommendations.description: Audit WA DSNP HMO AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION=Y auth-to-claim matching, denial enforcement, and claims processing for CRITICAL ACCESS, SNF - FREE STANDING, and Physical Rehab; if validated, initiate provider-level site-of-care and alternate-discharge leakage review.
evidence: WA authorization classification movement adds about +$1.3M.
WA critical access adds +$374K on 17 admissions.
WA SNF adds +$340K on 11 admissions.
Physical rehab adds +$195K on 3 admissions.
